title: SPACE: Main Health logs
description: Read-only Loki companion to the SPACE health dashboard. SPACE logs only; no third-party ingestion, traces, or vendor pipeline enrichment.

options.content:
Read-only panels work with Viewer access. Select the namespace and transport containing the services being investigated; host journals use **namespace = host** and **transport = journal**.

Original JSON is retained; fields are parsed at query time. Counts use a sliding `$window` window and are bounded by backend retention. Missing event series can mean no matching events or incomplete collection: use **SPACE log volume** and **Recent SPACE logs** as positive controls.

panels.title: SPACE log volume / $window
panels.description:
Additional local collection view.
Positive control, including non-JSON lines. This is log delivery, not service health.

panels.title: Warnings and errors / $window
panels.description:
Additional local collection view.
JSON level is case-sensitive. Absence is not filled with zero.

targets.expr: sum by (service, level) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json level="level" | level=~"WARN|ERROR" | __error__="" [$window]))

panels.title: Recent SPACE logs
panels.description:
Additional local collection view.
Original container/journal lines. Up to 500 newest matching records; expand a line for original JSON and structured metadata. No line_format rewriting.

panels.title: Sandbox Fail Reasons and Errors / $window
panels.description:
Sandbox Fail Reasons and Errors.
SPACE sandbox_failed domain events. Error/reason are parsed at query time only; broad error messages can still create query-time cardinality. No Datadog Flex tier.

targets.expr: sum by (reason, error, service) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_type="event_type", reason="reason", error="error" | event_type="sandbox_failed" | __error__=""[$window]))

panels.title: Sandbox failure reasons: top 10 / selected range
panels.description:
Sandbox Fail Reasons and Errors Top List.
Requires nonempty reason/error to match the source missing-field exclusions; top ten across the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (reason, error) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_type="event_type", reason="reason", error="error" | event_type="sandbox_failed" | __error__="" | reason!="" | error!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Connect 5xx: top 10 sandboxes / selected range
panels.description:
/connect 500s and 502s.
The source >=500 filter includes every 5xx, not just 500/502. Uses the emitted url.path when a parent-span route is absent. Sandbox IDs are parsed at query time, never indexed.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (sandbox_id) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_type="event_type", sandbox_id="sandbox_id", status=`["http.response.status_code"]`, path=`["url.path"]`, route=`span["http.route"]` | event_type="ecw_sandbox_api_request" | (route="/sandboxes/{sandboxID}/connect" or path=~"/sandboxes/[^/]+/connect") | sandbox_id!="" | status>=500 | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Unique sandboxes with connect errors / $window
panels.description:
Unique Sandboxes that users are unable to connect to repeatedly.
Distinct IDs with >=1 matching failed request in each sliding window. The source title says repeatedly, but its cardinality query does not require repeated failures; this panel does not imply that either.

targets.expr: count by (status) (sum by (status, sandbox_id) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_type="event_type", sandbox_id="sandbox_id", status=`["http.response.status_code"]`, path=`["url.path"]`, route=`span["http.route"]` | event_type="ecw_sandbox_api_request" | (route="/sandboxes/{sandboxID}/connect" or path=~"/sandboxes/[^/]+/connect") | sandbox_id!="" | status>=400 | __error__="" [$window])))

panels.title: Sandbox Activations by Boot Type / $window
panels.description:
Sandbox Activations by Boot Type.
Extracts JSON source as event_source, beside the log_source transport label.

targets.expr: sum by (boot_type) (count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_stream="event_stream", event_type="event_type", event_source="source", boot_type="boot_type", execution_generation="execution_generation" | event_stream="space.sandbox" | event_type="runtime_activated" | event_source="sbx_manager" | __error__="" [$window]))

panels.title: Fresh runtime activations with generation > 1 / $window
panels.description:
WIP Workspace Wipes.
Preserves the source WIP Workspace Wipes predicate. This is a diagnostic proxy, not proof that a user's workspace was wiped.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({log_source=~"${transport:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}",cluster=~"${cluster_id:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"} | json event_stream="event_stream", event_type="event_type", event_source="source", boot_type="boot_type", execution_generation="execution_generation" | event_stream="space.sandbox" | event_type="runtime_activated" | event_source="sbx_manager" | boot_type="fresh" | execution_generation>1 | __error__="" [$window]))

options.content: A **5xx minus successful spans** formula cannot be reproduced from logs alone: successful requests may not be logged, and no spans are collected here. Client-side events are out of scope. No current-emitter guarantee is made for panels whose source selector is not present in this checkout.
